Read dose-response data

Source: R/read.R
read_mst_dose_response.Rd

Reads the response of each ligand concentration from a dose-response export.

Usage

read_mst_dose_response(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an .xlsx file exported from MO.Affinity Analysis.

Value

A tibble with one row per concentration per series. It always has columns merge_set, target, target_concentration, ligand, ligand_concentration, response_type and response, followed by the other settings in the export.

  • response_type is one of "fnorm", "delta_fnorm" or "fraction_bound", depending on how the data was exported. Fnorm and delta Fnorm are in per mille.

  • series numbers the merge sets in the order they appear in the export, to tell apart series that share a name. It matches series in read_mst_fit() and read_mst_fit_curve().

  • error is the error of the mean response.

Concentrations are molar.

Details

  • Compare Results (Chart) and Dose-Response (Grouped) exports give the mean response of each concentration in each merge set, with its error. Capillaries marked as outliers are excluded.

  • Dose-Response (Flat) exports give the Fnorm of every capillary. They do not record which capillaries were marked as outliers, so all are included; join to read_mst_traces() by run and capillary to find them.

Note that dates of measurement in Dose-Response (Flat) exports appear to be in UTC, while other exports use the local time of the instrument computer. Both are returned as recorded, labelled as UTC.

Examples

read_mst_dose_response(tidymst_example("dppr10-cy5_compare-fnorm.xlsx"))

#>    series merge_set      target target_concentration ligand ligand_concentration
